source.probe: probed line factor 1.36 split as DengXian hhea 0.810/0.232 plus half the remainder each side

note:
Office-private CJK faces (DengXian, PMingLiU) are not visible to Chromium, so
their stand-ins lay lines out with the stand-in's own ascent/descent; Word
lays them out with the real face: line = the probed factor, split as the
face's hhea ascent/descent plus half the remainder on each side (DengXian
0.810/0.232 -> 0.969/0.391 of 1.36; PMingLiU 0.801/0.199 -> 0.952/0.351 of
1.3029). These aliases lead the chains and carry that geometry over the
stand-in's glyphs; U+0020 in the range makes them the primary face for the
line box, other scripts fall through to the chain.

faces.src: local('DengXian-Bold'), local('DengXian Bold'), local('PingFangSC-Semibold'), local('PingFang SC Semibold')
